versos.grego: Ἀνὴρ δέ τις Ἀνανίας ὀνόματι σὺν Σαπφείρῃ τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπώλησεν κτῆμα,

controles.web: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira, his wife, sold a possession,
controles.kjv: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
controles.livre: E um certo homem, de nome Ananias, com Safira, sua mulher, vendeu uma propriedade de terra.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐνοσφίσατο ἀπὸ τῆς τιμῆς, συνειδυίης καὶ τῆς γυναικός, καὶ ἐνέγκας μέρος τι παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἀποστόλων ἔθηκεν.

controles.web: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
controles.kjv: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
controles.livre: E escondeu parte do valor, sabendo também a mulher dele; e trazendo uma certa parte, depositou -a junto aos pés dos apóstolos.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος Ἀνανία, διὰ τί ἐπλήρωσεν ὁ Σατανᾶς τὴν καρδίαν σου, ψεύσασθαί σε τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον καὶ νοσφίσασθαι ἀπὸ τῆς τιμῆς τοῦ χωρίου;

controles.web: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
controles.kjv: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
controles.livre: E Pedro disse: Ananias, por que Satanás encheu teu coração, para que mentisses ao Espírito Santo, e escondesses parte do valor da propriedade?

versos.grego: οὐχὶ μένον σοὶ ἔμενεν καὶ πραθὲν ἐν τῇ σῇ ἐξουσίᾳ ὑπῆρχεν; τί ὅτι ἔθου ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο; οὐκ ἐψεύσω ἀνθρώποις ἀλλὰ τῷ Θεῷ.

controles.web: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”
controles.kjv: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
controles.livre: Se mantivesses tua propriedade ,ela não seria mantida contigo? E, tendo sido vendida, o dinheiro da venda não estava em teu poder? Por que decidiste isto em teu coração? Não mentiste aos seres humanos, mas sim a Deus.

versos.grego: ἀκούων δὲ ὁ Ἀνανίας τοὺς λόγους τούτους πεσὼν ἐξέψυξεν· καὶ ἐγένετο φόβος μέγας ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀκούοντας.

controles.web: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.
controles.kjv: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
controles.livre: E Ananias, ao ouvir estas palavras, caiu e deixou de respirar. E veio um grande temor sobre todos os que ouviram isso.

versos.grego: ἀναστάντες δὲ οἱ νεώτεροι συνέστειλαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐξενέγκαντες ἔθαψαν.

controles.web: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.
controles.kjv: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
controles.livre: E os rapazes, tendo se levantado, levaram-no fora, e o sepultaram.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ὡς ὡρῶν τριῶν διάστημα καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ μὴ εἰδυῖα τὸ γεγονὸς εἰσῆλθεν.

controles.web: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
controles.kjv: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
controles.livre: E passando o intervalo de cerca de três horas, entrou também sua mulher, não sabendo o que tinha acontecido.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ πρὸς αὐτὴν Πέτρος Εἰπέ μοι, εἰ τοσούτου τὸ χωρίον ἀπέδοσθε; ἡ δὲ εἶπεν Ναί, τοσούτου.

controles.web: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.”   She said, “Yes, for so much.”
controles.kjv: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
controles.livre: E Pedro disse a ela: Dize-me, vendestes por aquele tanto aquela propriedade?E ela disse: Sim, por aquele tanto.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος πρὸς αὐτήν Τί ὅτι συνεφωνήθη ὑμῖν πειράσαι τὸ Πνεῦμα Κυρίου; ἰδοὺ οἱ πόδες τῶν θαψάντων τὸν ἄνδρα σου ἐπὶ τῇ θύρᾳ καὶ ἐξοίσουσίν σε.

controles.web: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”
controles.kjv: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
controles.livre: E Pedro lhe disse: Por que vós fizestes acordo para tentar ao Espírito do Senhor? Eis que estão à porta os pés daqueles que sepultaram a teu marido, e eles também te levarão.

versos.grego: ἔπεσεν δὲ παραχρῆμα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξέψυξεν· εἰσελθόντες δὲ οἱ νεανίσκοι εὗρον αὐτὴν νεκράν, καὶ ἐξενέγκαντες ἔθαψαν πρὸς τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς.

controles.web: She fell down immediately at his feet, and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.
controles.kjv: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
controles.livre: E imediatamente ela caiu junto aos pés deles, e deixou de respirar. E os rapazes, ao entrarem, encontraram-na morta; e levando- a fora, sepultaram-na junto ao marido dela.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο φόβος μέγας ἐφ’ ὅλην τὴν ἐκκλησίαν καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀκούοντας ταῦτα.

controles.web: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.
controles.kjv: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
controles.livre: E veio um grande temor em toda a igreja, e em todos que ouviram estas coisas.

versos.grego: Διὰ δὲ τῶν χειρῶν τῶν ἀποστόλων ἐγίνετο σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα πολλὰ ἐν τῷ λαῷ· καὶ ἦσαν ὁμοθυμαδὸν πάντες ἐν τῇ στοᾷ Σολομῶντος·

controles.web: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
controles.kjv: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
controles.livre: E pelas mãos dos apóstolos foram feitos muitos sinais e milagres entre o povo. E estavam todos em concordância no alpendre de Salomão.

versos.grego: τῶν δὲ λοιπῶν οὐδεὶς ἐτόλμα κολλᾶσθαι αὐτοῖς, ἀλλ’ ἐμεγάλυνεν αὐτοὺς ὁ λαός·

controles.web: None of the rest dared to join them, however the people honored them.
controles.kjv: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.
controles.livre: Mas dos outros, ninguém ousava se juntar a eles; porém o povo os honrava muito.

versos.grego: μᾶλλον δὲ προσετίθεντο πιστεύοντες τῷ Κυρίῳ, πλήθη ἀνδρῶν τε καὶ γυναικῶν·

controles.web: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.
controles.kjv: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
controles.livre: E cada vez mais os que criam no Senhor se aumentavam, multidões tanto de homens como de mulheres.

versos.grego: ὥστε καὶ εἰς τὰς πλατείας ἐκφέρειν τοὺς ἀσθενεῖς καὶ τιθέναι ἐπὶ κλιναρίων καὶ κραβάττων, ἵνα ἐρχομένου Πέτρου κἂν ἡ σκιὰ ἐπισκιάσῃ τινὶ αὐτῶν.

controles.web: They even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some of them.
controles.kjv: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
controles.livre: De maneira que traziam os enfermos às ruas, e os botavam em camas e macas, para que, vindo Pedro, pelo menos a sombra dele cobrisse a alguns deles.

versos.grego: συνήρχετο δὲ καὶ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν πέριξ πόλεων Ἱερουσαλήμ, φέροντες ἀσθενεῖς καὶ ὀχλουμένους ὑπὸ πνευμάτων ἀκαθάρτων, οἵτινες ἐθεραπεύοντο ἅπαντες.

controles.web: Multitudes also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people, and those who were tormented by unclean spirits: and they were all healed.
controles.kjv: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
controles.livre: E também das cidades vizinhas vinha uma multidão a Jerusalém, trazendo enfermos, e atormentados por espíritos imundos, os quais todos eram curados.

versos.grego: Ἀναστὰς δὲ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ πάντες οἱ σὺν αὐτῷ, ἡ οὖσα αἵρεσις τῶν Σαδδουκαίων, ἐπλήσθησαν ζήλου

controles.web: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy,
controles.kjv: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,
controles.livre: E levantando-se o sumo sacerdote, e todos os que estavam com ele (que eram do grupo sectário dos saduceus), eles se encheram de inveja.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπέβαλον τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀποστόλους καὶ ἔθεντο αὐτοὺς ἐν τηρήσει δημοσίᾳ.

controles.web: and laid hands on the apostles, and put them in public custody.
controles.kjv: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
controles.livre: E puseram suas mãos nos apóstolos, e os colocaram na prisão pública.

versos.grego: Ἄγγελος δὲ Κυρίου διὰ νυκτὸς ἤνοιξε τὰς θύρας τῆς φυλακῆς ἐξαγαγών τε αὐτοὺς εἶπεν

controles.web: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out, and said,
controles.kjv: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,
controles.livre: Mas um anjo do Senhor, durante a noite, abriu as portas da prisão; e levando-os para fora, disse:

versos.grego: Πορεύεσθε καὶ σταθέντες λαλεῖτε ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ τῷ λαῷ πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τῆς Ζωῆς ταύτης.

controles.web: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”
controles.kjv: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
controles.livre: Ide; ficai em pé, e falai no Templo ao povo todas as palavras desta vida.

versos.grego: ἀκούσαντες δὲ εἰσῆλθον ὑπὸ τὸν ὄρθρον εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἐδίδασκον. Παραγενόμενος δὲ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ οἱ σὺν αὐτῷ συνεκάλεσαν τὸ συνέδριον καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γερουσίαν τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ, καὶ ἀπέστειλαν εἰς τὸ δεσμωτήριον ἀχθῆναι αὐτούς.

controles.web: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak, and taught. But the high priest came, and those who were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
controles.kjv: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
controles.livre: E eles, ouvindo isto ,entraram de manhã cedo no templo, e ensinavam. Mas vindo o sumo sacerdote, e os que estavam com ele, chamaram ao Conselho Principal, e a todos os anciãos dos filhos de Israel, e mandaram à prisão, para que os trouxessem.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ παραγενόμενοι ὑπηρέται οὐχ εὗρον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ· ἀναστρέψαντες δὲ ἀπήγγειλαν

controles.web: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,
controles.kjv: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,
controles.livre: Mas quando os oficiais vieram, não os acharam na prisão; e voltando, anunciaram,

versos.grego: λέγοντες ὅτι Τὸ δεσμωτήριον εὕρομεν κεκλεισμένον ἐν πάσῃ ἀσφαλείᾳ καὶ τοὺς φύλακας ἑστῶτας ἐπὶ τῶν θυρῶν, ἀνοίξαντες δὲ ἔσω οὐδένα εὕρομεν.

controles.web: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”
controles.kjv: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
controles.livre: Dizendo: Nós achamos a prisão fechada, em toda segurança, e com os guardas que estavam fora junto às portas; mas quando as abrimos, a ninguém achamos dentro.

versos.grego: ὡς δὲ ἤκουσαν τοὺς λόγους τούτους ὅ τε στρατηγὸς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς, διηπόρουν περὶ αὐτῶν τί ἂν γένοιτο τοῦτο.

controles.web: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.
controles.kjv: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
controles.livre: Quando o sumo sacerdote, o chefe da guarda do Templo, e os chefes dos sacerdotes ouviram estas palavras, eles duvidaram deles quanto o que aquilo viria a ser.

versos.grego: παραγενόμενος δέ τις ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι Ἰδοὺ οἱ ἄνδρες, οὓς ἔθεσθε ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ, εἰσὶν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἑστῶτες καὶ διδάσκοντες τὸν λαόν.

controles.web: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”
controles.kjv: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
controles.livre: E vindo alguém, anunciou-lhes, dizendo: Eis que os homens que vós pusestes na prisão estão no Templo, e ensinam ao povo.

versos.grego: Τότε ἀπελθὼν ὁ στρατηγὸς σὺν τοῖς ὑπηρέταις ἦγεν αὐτούς, οὐ μετὰ βίας, ἐφοβοῦντο γὰρ τὸν λαόν, μὴ λιθασθῶσιν·

controles.web: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.
controles.kjv: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
controles.livre: Então foi o chefe da guarda do Templo com os oficiais, e os trouxe, mas não com violência, porque temiam ao povo, para que não fossem apedrejados.

versos.grego: ἀγαγόντες δὲ αὐτοὺς ἔστησαν ἐν τῷ συνεδρίῳ. καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτοὺς ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς

controles.web: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,
controles.kjv: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
controles.livre: E quando os trouxeram, apresentaram-nos ao Supremo Conselho. E o sumo sacerdote perguntou a eles, dizendo:

versos.grego: λέγων Παραγγελίᾳ παρηγγείλαμεν ὑμῖν μὴ διδάσκειν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ, καὶ ἰδοὺ πεπληρώκατε τὴν Ἱερουσαλὴμ τῆς διδαχῆς ὑμῶν, καὶ βούλεσθε ἐπαγαγεῖν ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς τὸ αἷμα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου.

controles.web: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”
controles.kjv: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.
controles.livre: Não vos ordenamos expressamente para não ensinardes mais neste nome? E eis que vós enchestes a Jerusalém com vossa doutrina, e quereis trazer sobre nós o sangue deste homem!

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Πέτρος καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι εἶπαν Πειθαρχεῖν δεῖ Θεῷ μᾶλλον ἢ ἀνθρώποις.

controles.web: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
controles.kjv: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
controles.livre: E Pedro, respondendo com os apóstolos, disseram: Maior obrigação é obedecer a Deus do que às pessoas.

versos.grego: ὁ Θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἤγειρεν Ἰησοῦν, ὃν ὑμεῖς διεχειρίσασθε κρεμάσαντες ἐπὶ ξύλου·

controles.web: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
controles.kjv: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
controles.livre: O Deus de nossos Pais ressuscitou a Jesus, ao qual vós matastes, pendurando -o no madeiro.

versos.grego: τοῦτον ὁ Θεὸς Ἀρχηγὸν καὶ Σωτῆρα ὕψωσεν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ τοῦ δοῦναι μετάνοιαν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν.

controles.web: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
controles.kjv: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
controles.livre: A este Deus exaltou com sua mão direita por Príncipe e Salvador, para dar a Israel arrependimento e perdão de pecados.

versos.grego: καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν μάρτυρες τῶν ῥημάτων τούτων, καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον ὃ ἔδωκεν ὁ Θεὸς τοῖς πειθαρχοῦσιν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: We are His witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
controles.kjv: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
controles.livre: E nós somos testemunhas dele quanto a estas palavras, e também o Espírito Santo, o qual Deus tem dado a aqueles que lhe obedecem.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες διεπρίοντο καὶ ἐβούλοντο ἀνελεῖν αὐτούς.

controles.web: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and determined to kill them.
controles.kjv: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
controles.livre: E eles, ouvindo isto ,retalharam-se de raiva, e planejaram matá-los.

versos.grego: Ἀναστὰς δέ τις ἐν τῷ συνεδρίῳ Φαρισαῖος ὀνόματι Γαμαλιήλ, νομοδιδάσκαλος τίμιος παντὶ τῷ λαῷ, ἐκέλευσεν ἔξω βραχὺ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ποιῆσαι,

controles.web: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.
controles.kjv: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
controles.livre: Mas, levantando-se no Supremo Conselho um certo fariseu, de nome Gamaliel, instrutor da Lei, bem honrado por todo o povo, ele mandou levarem aos apóstolos para fora por um pouco de tempo .

versos.grego: εἶπέν τε πρὸς αὐτούς Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλεῖται, προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς ἐπὶ τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τούτοις τί μέλλετε πράσσειν.

controles.web: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.
controles.kjv: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
controles.livre: E lhes disse: Homens israelitas, olhai por vós mesmos, quanto ao que haveis de fazer a estes homens;

versos.grego: πρὸ γὰρ τούτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἀνέστη Θευδᾶς, λέγων εἶναί τινα ἑαυτόν, ᾧ προσεκλίθη ἀνδρῶν ἀριθμὸς ὡς τετρακοσίων· ὃς ἀνῃρέθη, καὶ πάντες ὅσοι ἐπείθοντο αὐτῷ διελύθησαν καὶ ἐγένοντο εἰς οὐδέν.

controles.web: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed, and came to nothing.
controles.kjv: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
controles.livre: Porque antes destes dias se levantou Teudas, dizendo ser alguém; ao qual se ajuntaram cerca de quatrocentos homens; ao qual foi morto, e todos os que acreditavam nele foram dispersos, e reduzidos a nada.

versos.grego: μετὰ τοῦτον ἀνέστη Ἰούδας ὁ Γαλιλαῖος ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῆς ἀπογραφῆς καὶ ἀπέστησεν λαὸν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ· κἀκεῖνος ἀπώλετο, καὶ πάντες ὅσοι ἐπείθοντο αὐτῷ διεσκορπίσθησαν.

controles.web: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
controles.kjv: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
controles.livre: Depois deste se levantou Judas, o galileu, nos dias do censo; e perverteu muito do povo atrás dele; e este também pereceu, e todos os que acreditavam nele foram dispersos.

versos.grego: καὶ τὰ νῦν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀπόστητε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων τούτων καὶ ἄφετε αὐτούς· ὅτι ἐὰν ᾖ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἡ βουλὴ αὕτη ἢ τὸ ἔργον τοῦτο, καταλυθήσεται·

controles.web: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men, and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
controles.kjv: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
controles.livre: E agora, eu vos digo, afastai-vos destes homens, e deixai-os; porque se este conselho ou esta obra for humana, ela se desfará.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ἐκ Θεοῦ ἐστιν, οὐ δυνήσεσθε καταλῦσαι αὐτούς, μή ποτε καὶ θεομάχοι εὑρεθῆτε. ἐπείσθησαν δὲ αὐτῷ,

controles.web: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
controles.kjv: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
controles.livre: Mas se é de Deus, vós não a podereis desfazer; para que não venhais a ser achados de também lutardes contra Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενοι τοὺς ἀποστόλους δείραντες παρήγγειλαν μὴ λαλεῖν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἀπέλυσαν.

controles.web: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
controles.kjv: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
controles.livre: E concordaram com ele. E chamando aos apóstolos, tendo os açoitado, mandaram -lhes que não mais falassem no nome de Jesus; e os deixaram ir.

versos.grego: Οἱ μὲν οὖν ἐπορεύοντο χαίροντες ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ συνεδρίου, ὅτι κατηξιώθησαν ὑπὲρ τοῦ Ὀνόματος ἀτιμασθῆναι·

controles.web: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.
controles.kjv: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
controles.livre: Então eles saíram da presença do Supremo Conselho, alegres por terem sido considerados dignos de serem humilhados por causa do nome dele.

versos.grego: πᾶσάν τε ἡμέραν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ κατ’ οἶκον οὐκ ἐπαύοντο διδάσκοντες καὶ εὐαγγελιζόμενοι τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν.

controles.web: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
controles.kjv: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: E todos os dias no Templo, e pelas casas, não paravam de ensinar e de anunciar a Jesus Cristo.
